title: phyllagathis osmantha
intro: Phyllagathis osmantha, commonly known as the Indian plume flower, is a type of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties.
